requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Cause number, if one was assigned
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number, if one was assigned
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the cause number if one was assigned, copied from your papers - if none was assigned, write none, because that decides the MC case-type question the petition branch turns on

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County where the infraction was handled
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County where the infraction was handled
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Indiana county where the infraction was handled, from your own papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Was prosecution deferred, answered from your own papers
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Was prosecution deferred, answered from your own papers
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the deferral answer routes between the automatic rule and the five-year branch, and only the participant's papers hold it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether prosecution was deferred - the automatic rule does not apply where it was, and the five-year branch does

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Answer from the records office of the court where the infraction was handled - was a non-disclosure order under I.C. 34-28-5-15 already entered in your cause
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Answer from the records office of the court where the infraction was handled - was a non-disclosure order under I.C. 34-28-5-15 already entered in your cause
requiredBeforeFiling.why: whether the court already acted is a fact only that court's records hold
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the answer you are given when you ask the office of the clerk of the court where the infraction was handled whether an order under I.C. 34-28-5-15 was entered in your cause - write it down, because where the order exists there is nothing to file

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the matter ended, and on what date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the matter ended, and on what date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the infraction matter ended (never prosecuted, dismissed, found not to have committed it, adjudication vacated, deferral completed, or judgment satisfied) and the date it did - the earliest filing dates run from this

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Cause number, or the MC case-type number the clerk gives you where none was assigned
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number, or the MC case-type number the clerk gives you where none was assigned
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the cause number is a case identifier the platform has not seen, and the MC case-type convention is an open county-practice question the family's own records assign to the participant and the clerk
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the original cause number; and where no cause number was ever assigned, the MC case-type number the clerk of that county tells you to use - ask the clerk, because county handling of the MC case-type assignment is not uniform and this packet will not guess it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The answer the clerk gave about whether an order was already entered - paragraph 5
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The answer the clerk gave about whether an order was already entered - paragraph 5
requiredBeforeFiling.why: whether the court already acted is a fact only that court's records hold, and it decides whether this petition should be filed at all
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the answer the office of the clerk of that court gave when you asked whether an order under I.C. 34-28-5-15 was already entered in your cause - if it was, do not file this petition

requiredBeforeFiling.why: no county fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Indiana county that court sits in, copied from your own papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court the petition is captioned to - the court where the charges were brought or the trial was held
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court the petition is captioned to - the court where the charges were brought or the trial was held
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the venue is a case fact the platform has not seen, and the memo states it as a rule rather than as a value
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the Indiana court where the charges were brought or the trial was held, or, on the deferral branch, the court with jurisdiction over the violation - copied from your own papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The earliest filing date computed under the applicable rule - paragraph 4
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The earliest filing date computed under the applicable rule - paragraph 4
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the computation depends on the participant's own disposition and date, which the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date computed from paragraph 3 under the rule printed in paragraph 4, which must already have passed before you file

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the matter ended, and the date - paragraph 3
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the matter ended, and the date - paragraph 3
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the disposition and its date decide which earliest-filing rule applies, and only the participant's papers hold them
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which of the six recorded dispositions applies - never prosecuted, dismissed with no new action filed, adjudged not to have committed it, an adjudication vacated, a deferral programme completed, or a judgment satisfied - and the date it happened

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The infraction, and the county and court in which it was handled - paragraph 2
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The infraction, and the county and court in which it was handled - paragraph 2
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no infraction fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the infraction as your papers describe it, with the county and court that handled it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The prosecuting attorney served, and the address used - paragraph 7
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The prosecuting attorney served, and the address used - paragraph 7
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no prosecuting-attorney address for any Indiana county and does not guess one
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the prosecuting attorney you serve and the address you use, written after service actually happens

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature of Petitioner
protectedBlanks.why: a verification dated before the petition is actually filed would be false

protectedBlanks.label: The Court's order on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: the Court rules on the petition; the block is printed so the order has somewhere to go and is never completed by this build

protectedBlanks.label: Judge's signature and the date of the order
protectedBlanks.why: the judge signs the order; nothing on this line belongs to the participant or to this build
